title: 第7章 兽娘第8章 又见面了
lines: 格林在教训完混混后，继续在街上走着，因为露脸总会引人注意，后面干脆直接用斗篷把脸遮住，哪怕他不喜欢遮遮掩掩也没有办法了。
好在遮遮掩掩的人很多，格林不会过于明显。
格林还发现了有趣的事，之前没有注意。
现在看来，这个世界的语言根本不是蓝星的语言，可是自己又听得懂。
甚至于在冒险协会的时候，他能够听懂各地人士的方言，没有任何一种语言是他无法识别的。
这是他的穿越者福利吗？谁给的？还是因为他自己？算了，现在想不到就不想了，还有更重要的事：
他遇到扒手了。
看着快速远去的背影，格林略微思索了一下，如果那个人只是一个普通的扒手，格林可能揍一顿就完事了。
摸索一下剩余的钱袋，格林感到有点意思：他自己的钱袋和从混混手中抢到的三个钱袋中，她偷走了钱最少的那个。
那是谁的，格林根本就不记得，只知道那个钱袋里的钱不多，大概3个银币的样子吧。
但是……
这种小偷就要将她抓回去打倒在地，然后狠狠惩罚啊！
有条不紊地跟着那个藏匿在宽大衣服下的身影，格林打算观察对方要做什么，自己这样偷偷的跟踪，感觉……好……
兴奋啊！
对方买了一只烤鸡和一些面包走进了一个小巷里，格林看着她将吃的分给一些儿童，然后她和儿童一块吃了起来。
挺不错的，可是偷东西是不对的。
格林：“你偷了多少人的钱了？”
格林：“是我。”
之前没有发现我？自己的潜行技巧提高了？看来是因为杀死血藤精带来的提升，那股黑烟可以获取生命的部分能力？
“好歹也是见过面了，就不记得了？”
虽然格林没有露面，但是格林身上斗篷还是记得的。
果不其然，小偷在看到格林身上的斗篷后立刻想了起来：
“是你，抱……抱歉，我会还你的。
真的！
我每次偷钱后都会还回去的。”
“如果你以后找不到我呢？”
“所以，你刚刚撒谎了。”
“这……这是为了帮助其他人，反正你们这种有钱人损失一点又不会怎么样，但是这点钱却可以救很多人。”
“劫富济贫？如果你没有撒谎，我对你的印象分还挺高的。
可惜你只偷点小钱，为什么不搞点大动作？”
看着眼前的半兽人，格林赞叹不愧是异世界。
晨光掠过她蜷在墙角的背影，人类少女般的脸庞在砖墙阴影中显出天鹅绒般的质感。
睫毛如鸦羽般浓密，却在下眼睑投下蝶翼般的颤影。
content_en:
After teaching the gangster a lesson, Green continued walking on the street. Because showing his face would always attract attention, he simply covered his face with his cloak. Even if he didn't like to be secretive, there was nothing he could do.
Fortunately, there are many people who are secretive, so Green will not be too obvious.
Green also discovered something interesting that he had not noticed before.
Now it seems that the language of this world is not the language of Blue Star at all, but I can understand it.
Even when he was in the Adventure Association, he could understand the dialects of people from all over the world, and there was no language that he could not recognize.
Is this his time traveler benefit? Who gave it? Or is it because of himself? Forget it, forget it now if you can’t think of it, there are more important things:
He encountered a pickpocket.
Looking at the back of the person who was quickly walking away, Green thought for a moment. If that person was just an ordinary pickpocket, Green would probably give him a beating and be done with it.
After groping for the remaining money bags, Green found something interesting: among his own money bags and the three money bags snatched from the gangsters, she stole the one with the least money.
Green didn't remember who it belonged to. He only knew that there wasn't much money in the purse, about three silver coins.
But...
This kind of thief will catch her and knock her to the ground, and then punish her severely!
Methodically following the figure hidden under the loose clothes, Green planned to observe what the other person was going to do. Following him secretly like this, he felt... good...
So excited!
The other party bought a roast chicken and some bread and walked into an alley. Green watched her give the food to some children, and then she and the children ate together.
It's nice, but stealing is wrong.
Green: "How many people have you stolen money from?"
"Who is it?!"
Green: "It's me."
Didn't you notice me before? Have your stealth skills improved? It seems that due to the improvement brought by killing the blood vine spirit, that black smoke can gain part of the ability of life?
"Huh?"
"At any rate, we have met before, but you don't remember?"
Although Green did not show up, the cloak on Green was still remembered.
Sure enough, the thief immediately thought after seeing Green's cloak:
"It's you, hug... I'm sorry, I will return it to you.
Really!
Every time I steal money I pay it back. "
"What if you can't find me in the future?"
"..."
"So, you just lied."
"This... this is to help other people. Anyway, it won't matter to rich people like you if you lose a little, but this little money can save many people."
"Robbing the rich and giving to the poor? If you hadn't lied, I would have a pretty high impression of you.
It's a pity that you only stole a small amount of money, why don't you do something big? "
Looking at the half-orc in front of him, Green admired that it was indeed a different world.
The morning light passed over her back curled up in the corner, and her human girl-like face showed a velvety texture in the shadow of the brick wall.
The eyelashes are as thick as crow feathers, but cast a quivering shadow like butterfly wings on the lower eyelids.
title_en: Chapter 7 Beast Girl Chapter 8 We meet again
